en: ...BLRGBLRBLGHBLRBLGH!

Wh-Why Monodam...?
Why did you kill Monosuke...?
...BLRGBLRBLGHBLRBLGH!

IF-YOU-NEED-TO-VOMIT...LET-IT-OUT.
YOU-WILL-FEEL-MUCH-BETTER-AFTERWARD.

MONOSUKE... HE-WAS-NO-DIFFERENT-
FROM-MONOKID.

HE-WAS-GETTING-IN-THE-WAY...
OF-US-GETTING-ALONG.
WE-DON'T-NEED-HIM.
D-Don't need him...?

WE-FEW-REMAINING-MONOKUBS...
MUST-GET-ALONG.

NO-MATTER-WHAT...
WE-MUST-ALWAYS-GET-ALONG.

NOT-EVEN-FATHER-CAN-STOP-US-
FROM-GETTING-ALONG.

NOT-IF-HE-KNOWS-WHAT-IS-GOOD-
FOR-HIM.
Eh?

THIS-ACADEMY-BELONGS-TO-US...
THE-<CLT=cltSTRONG>AGE-OF-THE-MONOKUBS<CLT=cltNORMAL>-BEGINS-NOW.
...HA-HA-HA-HA.
...BLRGBLRBLGHBLRBLGHBLRBLGH!

H-How dare you take that rebellious
tone with me, young man...

And yet, this angsty attitude of yours
is just so cute!

It's so cute how your little crew has
shrunk by one member!

Yep, shrunk! You're not getting
any larger, y'know!?
Ahhh... It's so unbearably cute...

All this cuteness makes me feel like I'm
about to sneeze...
Ah...ah...ah...
Ah-gly bitch!
Who you callin' an ugly bitch!?

It doesn't matter!
Now's not the time for that!
Ghhh... Kirumi!

I...I can't take this anymore...
Even Kirumi was killed so brutally...

WAAAAAAAAAAAHHHHHHHHHHH!!!!!
I DON'T WANNA DO THIS ANYMOOORE!!!!!
A-Am I...gonna...end up like that too...?

I-I won't let that happen, Himiko!
I'll protect you, no matter what!
I'll protect you, no matter what...

B-But...I don't wanna do this anymore
either...

Please...let's just stop this killing game...
I don't care if we stay trapped here forever...
...Oh? Isn't that what Atua said?

All desire, even your desire to escape this
place, can corrupt you beyond redemption.

It's Monokuma who is corrupt. He is the one
who distributed the <CLT=cltSTRONG>motive videos<CLT=cltNORMAL>.

Those videos were more dangerous than we 
thought. To have driven Kirumi that far...

What worries me is, as long as we're trapped
here, we don't know what's true or false.

That must be why Kirumi did
not want to show the videos.

She thought that if everyone felt the
same murderous rage that she did...

this killing game would be pure chaos.
She...wanted to stop it.

If that's the case, then we really shouldn't
show our videos to each other!

That was our consensus from the beginning.
Not including you, of course.

I had assumed Kokichi would try to show 
us our videos to...get under our skin.

But that did not come to pass.
What, I wonder, were his intentions...?

Huh? I'd never do anything like that.
I'm still thinking about what Kirumi said.
What Kirumi said...?

Everything you just saw is true, though I only
remembered it upon watching that video.
What she said earlier, correct?
Huh? What about it?

She said she remembered...and it didn't
sound like a lie, either.

Maybe that video had the properties of a
<CLT=cltSTRONG>Flashback Light<CLT=cltNORMAL> if it made her remember.

Huh? The properties of 
a Flashback Light?

Still...how could Kirumi remember something
she never should have forgotten?

Serving the entire nation seems too
important for her to just...forget.
Nyeh...that's true.

Does that mean we have <CLT=cltSTRONG>motives to kill<CLT=cltNORMAL> that
we'll remember by watching our videos?

And if that's the case, maybe it's for
the best that we don't watch the videos.

As long as we don't see the videos,
we won't know our <CLT=cltSTRONG>motives<CLT=cltNORMAL>.

Yeah, now I'm convinced.
It's probably for the best.

Those <CLT=cltSTRONG>motive videos<CLT=cltNORMAL> would mess us up,
it's better if we just believe in each other.

That's right! It's best that we not remember
our <CLT=cltSTRONG>motives<CLT=cltNORMAL>, for everyone's sake!

Hearing you speak of "<CLT=cltSTRONG>everyone's sake<CLT=cltNORMAL>"
is the least believable lie I've heard yet...

How rude. I'm always doing stuff for
everyone's sake.

I'm sure you won't believe me when I say
stuff like that, so I'll just keep lying...

But maybe seeing Kirumi's final moments
has made me change my views.

She tried to escape until the very end...
Running away to live...might not be a bad idea.

Maybe...
Maybe facing the truth isn't enough.

Yeah, true... It's okay to run sometimes.
You just gotta win in the end.
That's all you gotta do...

<CLT=cltMIND>And with that, the 2nd
class trial ended for us.

<CLT=cltMIND>A pyrrhic victory.
We had still lost a friend.

<CLT=cltMIND>What is the <CLT=cltSTRONG>end<CLT=cltMIND> Kaito spoke of,
and how do we reach it?
<CLT=cltMIND>I don't know. I still don't know.
Yes
No
Something wrong?
<CLT=cltSYSTEM>Would you like to leave the area?
